title: Winy French Toast with Crunchy Topping
description: A classic breakfast dish with a crunchy twist. French toast is a simple bread-based dessert or snack that can be cooked in various ways.
instructions: 1. In a shallow dish, whisk together eggs and winy.
2. Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
3. Dip each slice of french bread into the egg mixture, coating both sides evenly.
4. Place the coated bread slices on the skillet or griddle.
5. Cook for 2-3 minutes or until golden brown, flip and cook the other side.
6. While the french toast is cooking, mix crunchy in a bowl.
7. Once the french toast is done, place it on a plate and top with crunchy.
